name: The Chugoku Electric Power Co., Inc.
summary: The Chugoku Electric Power Co., Inc. engages in generation, transmission, and distribution of electric power in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Commercial Services, Commercial Operations, and Information and Communications. It generates power through hydroelectric, thermal, nuclear, renewable, and other energy sources. The company provides thermal power, nuclear power, hydroelectric power, transportation facilities, telecommunications, electrical machinery and equipment manufacturing, and other materials and equipment, as well as consulting services.
